title: 2 BOXES OF AVON GLASS - DINNER...
reason: Large collection of Avon Cape Cod ruby glass, a collected pattern with sellable extras; the Avon claim is supported by pattern, not by marks. Heavy and fragile, and the pattern is common.
findings: Ruby red pressed glass in the Avon 1876 Cape Cod pattern (matched by the diamond and cross-hatch band, hexagonal bases and scalloped rims; no maker's marks or Avon labels visible, and the pattern is normally unmarked). Roughly 60 to 80 pieces: stacks of dinner plates, salad plates and shallow bowls (one ruby plate displayed on top), four footed mugs, five hexagonal salt and pepper shakers, about 13 napkin rings (ten in the large bowl, three in front), the large diamond-cut serving bowl, and a small hexagonal tray with a gold script logo that is illegible at this resolution. Lot 470 is a further 3 boxes of the same pattern. The pattern is common, so the value is in the volume and the better extras (mugs, shakers, napkin rings).
condition: No chips or cracks visible at photo resolution, but rim chips on stacked plates and bowls are hard to spot. Some dust or marks on the napkin rings in photo 3. Stacked without protection.
rescore_note: About 60 to 80 pieces of ruby glass that matches Avon 1876 Cape Cod by pattern only (no marks seen); a well-collected but common pattern where volume and extras (mugs, shakers, napkin rings) carry the value, though heavy, fragile and chips unchecked, so upper part of the $80 to 200 band. (no web price check)
